newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb trade data to include Jan oil imports.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb trade data to include Jan oil imports.

text.p: Brazil's February trade figures will include all of federally-owned oil company Petrobras' imports which were not registered in January due to problems in a new import registry, a Finance Ministry official said.
"When we announce the February trade figures, they are going to contain Petrobras' imports," said Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, the Finance Ministry's secretary of economic policy.

Barros said only that Petrobras had imports in January which failed to appear on the government's Siscomex registry, and that the February result should not be too much larger than normal due to the carryover effect.
News reports Monday said Brazil's February trade gap could total $1.5 billion if the government included Petrobras' January imports.
